title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
description: Implement a trie with insert(word), search(word) for exact matches, and startsWith(prefix) to check whether any inserted word has the given prefix.

reference.use_case: Supporting fast inserts, exact lookups, and 'starts with' queries over a large set of strings, as in search-box autocomplete.
system_examples: Autocomplete in search bars and IDEs — suggesting completions for a typed prefix
Linux kernel IPv4 routing (fib_trie, an LC-trie) — longest-prefix match for route lookup
Ethereum — the Merkle Patricia Trie stores account and contract state
reference.explanation: A trie shares common prefixes, so lookups and prefix checks take O(L) in the key length regardless of how many keys exist, and all completions of a prefix live in one subtree. Compressed variants (radix/Patricia tries) power routing tables, autocomplete, and blockchain state.
